product_name_specific: TOYOTA AURIS, C-HR, COROLLA / LEXUS NX300, RX300
risk_description:
The resistance characteristics of the fuel pump components against high fuel pressure may be inadequate.
As a result,  cracks may be formed on the welded parts of the pump and a fuel leak may occur, posing a risk to the following traffic.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
